newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BRIGHTON ROCKED BY TWO-POINT FINE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BRIGHTON ROCKED BY TWO-POINT FINE.

text.p: Brighton's survival hopes were dealt a further blow on Monday when the English league's bottom club were docked two points.
Two pitch invasions by protesting fans in October prompted the English F.A. sanction and left the managerless side 11 points adrift at the foot of division three.
Brighton already had a suspended three-point fine and a one-match ground closure hanging over them following disturbances in April.

But the F.A . decided not to activate the suspended sentence in full once it decided they were guilty of failing to control their spectators. The club is suffering from internal strife and poised to become homeless at the end of the season after selling their ground without a positive alternative lined up.
